title: El que te quiere ver la cara
goal: Spot the one who actually is trying it on
culture: This is the only person in the whole game who is genuinely at it, and that is the point: almost nobody is, which is exactly why it works when somebody tries. No hay cambio, said after he has your note, is the oldest one at any terminal. The move is to be pleasant and not to move.

beats.es: Le cambio los dólares aquí mismo, mejor precio que el banco. ...Uy, fíjese que no hay cambio.
beats.good: He has your note in his hand and no change in the other. Said as a flat question rather than an accusation, this is where it starts going wrong for him.

beats.es: Ahorita consigo, deme un minutito. Espéreme aquí.
beats.good: Do not follow him and do not leave. Espere, said calmly, standing exactly where you are, ends most of these inside a minute.

beats.es: Bueno, bueno. Deme los otros cien y yo le doy todo junto ahorita.
beats.say: Yo le doy cuando tenga el cambio.
beats.en: I’ll hand it over when you have the change.
ok: yo le doy cuando tenga el cambio
beats.good: You hand yours over when he has the change in his hand. Said pleasantly it is not an accusation, and there is nothing in it for him to argue with.

beats.es: Ya pues, hombre, tenga. No sea así conmigo.
beats.en: Don’t come at me with that.
beats.good: No me venga con eso is the firmest thing in this entire game, and it is the right amount of firm for exactly one person in it.
